summary: Market Technology Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering on July 27, 2026. It issued and sold 20,500,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including 500,000 units from the over-allotment option, generating gross proceeds of $205 million. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-half of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The company entered into standard underwriting, warrant, trust, and registration rights agreements. This is a routine IPO closing report, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies.
